name: connector-audit
description: Audit every connector JSON file in this repo: one analyze pass per connector, then a chore-lane summary of the findings.

steps.prompt: List every .json filename in the connectors/ directory of this repository (excluding _schema.json and echo.json). Return ONLY a JSON array of the filenames, nothing else.

stepTemplate.prompt: Read connectors/{{item}} in this repository. In at most 120 words: (1) what pool does it define, (2) which meter window does it declare, (3) any inconsistency you can spot between its spawn command and its declared lanes or meter.

steps.prompt: The per-connector reviews are complete. Write a short markdown summary listing each connector with one line: its biggest risk or 'no issues found'. Do not re-read the files; rely on this completion signal.
